_doc: v17 AI motion (image-to-video) on REAL Dwarka photos: subtle natural motion only (water, waves, clouds, flags, light). Model + licence: config/model_licenses.json -> ai_motion_i2v. Used by core/ai_motion.py (kang.py ai-motion-plan / ai-motion-apply) and tools/kaggle_ai_motion/ai_motion_run.py.

model.name: Wan2.2-TI2V-5B
model._size_doc: v17 KANG_017: 1024x576 (exact 16:9, multiple of 32; 576 tokens per latent frame vs 880 at 1280x704) + transformer group offload (block level) on T4; 1280x704 / max_frames 121 / max_slow 1.75 OOMed on T4 (KANG_016). 960x544 not used: 544 rows > the 540 rows of a 960-wide 16:9 frame (centre-band composite needs mh <= mw*9/16). Upscale to 1920x1080 happens only inside the composite mask (core/ai_motion.py).
model._seed_doc: seed_overrides: v17 attempt 2 (KANG_021) new seed for the two clips eye-rejected in attempt 1 (S12_b01 fake bird, S11_b06 shoreline warp); other jobs keep seed 42.

prompts.sea: Static camera, locked-off tripod shot of a real photograph. Gentle sea waves roll softly onto the shore, water shimmers, clouds drift very slowly. Buildings, rocks and land stay completely still. No camera movement.
prompts.water: Static camera, locked-off tripod shot of a real photograph. The river water ripples gently and shimmers in the light, clouds drift very slowly. Buildings, steps and people stay completely still. No camera movement.
prompts.boat: Static camera, locked-off tripod shot of a real photograph. Gentle ripples on the sea water, the boats bob very slightly on the water, clouds drift slowly. The shore and buildings stay completely still. No camera movement.
prompts.flag: Static camera, locked-off tripod shot of a real photograph. The flag on top of the temple waves gently in the wind, clouds drift slowly across the sky. The temple stone and buildings stay completely still. No camera movement.
prompts.sky: Static camera, locked-off tripod shot of a real photograph. Clouds drift slowly across the sky, the light shimmers softly. Buildings and land stay completely still. No camera movement.
prompts.sea_flag: Static camera, locked-off tripod shot of a real photograph. Gentle sea waves move softly around the temple, the flag on top of the temple waves gently in the wind, clouds drift slowly. The temple and buildings stay completely still. No camera movement.

negative: camera movement, zoom, pan, tilt, dolly, shaking, handheld, new buildings, new people, new objects, morphing, warping, distortion, melting, text, subtitles, watermark, logo, fast motion, flicker, cartoon, painting, oversaturated, blurry, low quality, JPEG artifacts, people walking, crowd

gate._cell_flicker_doc: cell_flicker_fail applies to RIGID cells (>=50 % non-sky/water/flag pixels); cell_flicker_fluid_fail to mostly sky/water/flag cells, where a passing flag or breaking wave legitimately moves the cell mean. Calibrated 2026-11-04 KANG_018 on the first real Wan2.2 clips: the only cell-flicker failures (S16_b06 10.2, S11_b06 10.5) were inside the motion mask, outside-mask cells <= 1.8.
gate._flag_blob_doc: v17 attempt 2 (KANG_021): flag_* = flag colour core (union of saffron/red pixels over the photo + every AI frame, moving components only, dilated) -> 100 % AI inside, ghost_frac_fail = max share of frame pixels flag-coloured in the composite but not in the AI frame. blob_* = new bright / compact dark blobs inside the water/sky mask vs frame 0 (core/ai_motion.new_blobs) -> FAIL. sea_needs_limits: a beach (kind sea) clip FAILs without an eye-set mask_keep (open water + sky only, shoreline / wet sand = photo).

_mask_keep_doc: v17 attempt 2 (KANG_021): agent eye-set row limits (fraction of frame height) per beach/sea shot, from a row-grid view of the model inputs: AI pixels only above y_max (open water + sky), shoreline / breakers / wet sand = the photo. A sea or sea_flag clip without an entry FAILs the gate (gate.sea_needs_limits).
